prompt: Plan SENTINEL drone pose estimation via AprilTags: WP0 contract amendment (DronePoseReport, DRONE_POSE_REPORTED, drone_pose snapshot), sentinel.pose detector package, coordinator-ingestion slice feeding LocalPose/drone_pose to the run database

answers.question: Which detection method for drone pose?
answers.text: AprilTag 36h11 detection host-side via cv2.aruco + solvePnP(SOLVEPNP_IPPE_SQUARE) against a versioned tag-map fixture. The drone is a standard Tello (non-EDU): no Mission Pads, no EDU-only commands; detection runs on received 960x720 frames with nominal intrinsics (calibration_source: nominal).

answers.question: Is drone pose ever a flight-control input?
answers.text: No. Pose is evidence/read-model data only: it feeds DRONE_POSE_REPORTED events and the drone_pose snapshot read model. Flight remains the existing open-loop supervised command path; pose never mutates flight state in V0 (fail-closed boundary, SR-D).

answers.question: What contract changes are required?
answers.text: WP0 amendment: add DronePoseReport to the wire oneOf registry, add DRONE_POSE_REPORTED to the event enum, add drone_pose snapshot fields with the WP0 3.4 staleness rule; amend the V0 spec section 9 non-goals from GPS/localisation to GPS/global localisation, keeping room-local pose with source_kind provenance and never a GPS claim.

answers.question: How does pose reach the run database?
answers.text: A minimal coordinator-side ingestion slice appends DRONE_POSE_REPORTED events run-scoped to the SQLite store and projects them into drone_pose/LocalPose in the mountain snapshot; the full coordinator remains the WP1 boundary.

answers.question: How is this work package accepted?
answers.text: Acceptance is a user-approved supervised physical test run: detector implementations work, DB position updates, and real-time x/y/z terminal logging during the supervised run. All development and CI tests use synthetic rendered tag frames only; no live flight during implementation. Live rehearsal stays behind G4 operator consent.

answers.question: Safety and scope constraints?
answers.text: No live drone connection in any implementation task; G3 owner-approval over versioned image-set hash and G4 live rehearsal consent remain in force. Pose estimate is a room-local estimate, not GPS; judged/real-drone use is out of scope until the supervised acceptance run is explicitly consented by the owner.

challenges.response: Alternative considered: closed-loop position hold using pose as control input. Rejected for V0 because (a) acceptance is a supervised open-loop run and a control-loop change would need its own safety review; (b) pose accuracy on nominal intrinsics (fx=547, calibration_source: nominal) is uncharacterised, making it unsafe as a control signal; (c) the fail-closed boundary (SR-D) keeps the blast radius of detector bugs at 'wrong display data', never 'wrong motion'. Cost: the drone drifts uncorrected between open-loop commands; accepted because station dwell is short and the survey demo tolerates it.
